draft.emotion: helpful and direct, sharing a useful piece of news
notes: The second syllable 诉 is pronounced in the neutral tone (gàosu) in everyday speech.
Unlike 说 (shuō, 'to speak/say'), 告诉 takes the listener directly as its object (告诉他, 'tell him'). You cannot say 说他 to mean 'tell him'.
